events.title: Gwich'in Territorial Campground, NT
events.thought: End of day sixty. Crossed the Arctic Circle.

events.title: 'Watch for Aircraft' Sign, Dempster
events.thought: Only on the Dempster — watch for planes landing on the road.
events.photoCaption: 'Watch for Aircraft Landing on Highway' — a Dempster original, where bush pilots share the gravel strip with trucks.

events.title: Arctic Circle Monument
events.thought: LAT 66° 33 N — the Arctic Circle on the Dempster. That's real.
events.photoCaption: The Arctic Circle monument at Lat 66° 33 N on the Dempster Highway, vast tundra rolling to the horizon.

events.title: Muskox on Arctic Tundra
events.thought: First muskox — they look exactly like what came out of the last ice age.
events.photoCaption: A solitary muskox stands on the Arctic tundra of the Dempster corridor, staring down the camera.

events.title: Dempster Sunset
events.thought: The Dempster sunset doesn't negotiate — it just burns.
events.photoCaption: Fiery sunset over the fall tundra of the Dempster Highway, burnt spruce silhouettes and a sky on fire.
